pages.text: The $(bold)Wagon Companion$(reset) task takes a passenger position on a double or triple driver’s bench. $(bold)Wagon Passenger$(reset) finds a free cargo stool with clearance. Changing tasks makes her dismount.$(br2)Leads and Carry On can also seat maids. Select the appropriate task to keep them aboard.

pages.title: Mounted Ranged Combat
pages.text: While seated, holding a bow, crossbow or TACZ gun lets her attack nearby hostiles without dismounting. Supply the ammunition used by her normal weapon tasks.$(br2)Weapon swapping selects the matching native attack behavior. Target selection, ammunition and weapon enchantments follow Touhou Little Maid’s normal rules. The maid keeps her passenger seat while attacking.

At rest time, maids seek beds or wagon mats using the original priorities. Sleep follows a moving wagon; mat removal wakes them with the original affection rules.$(br2)Filled photos or soul talismans release maids on the wagon. Capture uses the original tools and conditions, including their sleeping-maid rules.
